messages:
Mira: quick ask — need deal desk sign-off on a bespoke concession for Delta Systems. They want a 42% discount off list for a 12mo $200k committed package (Dedicated + Private deploy) + SOC2 attestation. PO C->Prod timeline is tight, they want contract signed by Fri EOD.
Sam-RevOps: 42% is large — what are the concessions beyond $ discount? onboarding waived? extended trial? prepay?
Mira: yes — proposing: waive onboarding fee ($25k), 2 months free (as credit), and 42% off recurring. Requesting customer to prepay first 6 months to protect cash. Reasoning: strategic healthcare account, reference potential, expected expansion to 2–3x next year.
Lee-Finance: give me gross margin impact quick. If list ARR = $200k, 42% off -> $116k net ARR. Waived onboarding is one-time. Estimated FY1 margin after infra = ~28% vs our target 35%. Need prepay or 18mo commit to approve from finance.
Paula-Legal: two legal items: 1) is Delta pushing for indemnities or reverse IP? 2) need DPA + Security addendum. If private/on-prem, we may need explicit data isolation language. No legal block if standard DPA + standard indemnities, but flag for exec review if they request anything custom.
Olivia-SE: technical note — Dedicated + Private with SOC2 for POC = non-trivial ops work. I'll estimate ~2 FTE-weeks for infra prep + 4 weeks for on-site integration testing. Suggest we offer a scoped POC (6 weeks, limited dataset) to reduce ops tail. Also: can we add a capped onboarding engineering credit ($15k) instead of waiving onboarding entirely? cheaper for us.
Mira: customer pushing hard for full environment to validate compliance. They said minimal time to evaluate unless we give them prod-like env.
Devon-Cust: appreciate the team's flexibility — signing this week is ideal. We can prepay first 6 months today if legal & PM confirm minimal SOW for POC.
Sam-RevOps: two paths we can approve quickly: (A) 42% discount + 12mo commit IF customer prepays 6 months and we keep onboarding credit capped at $15k, OR (B) 30% discount with standard onboarding waived and no prepay. Which does the AE prefer?
Mira: prefer A — customer already confirmed prepay verbally. We should lock price and get signature this week.
Lee-Finance: conditional approval for A if legal signs off and we get 6mo prepay + auto-renew clause + minimum 12mo. Need amendment for early termination fees.
Paula-Legal: can do standard amendments. I'll prepare DPA + SOC2 addendum. If they request custom indemnity, need legal SLA review — ping me directly.
Olivia-SE: accepted the $15k capped onboarding credit vs full waiver. That keeps ops scope realistic.
DealBot: Deal submitted to Deal Desk queue by Mira — ticket #DD-2026-784. Link: https://redwood/deals/DD-2026-784 (auto-note).
Sam-RevOps: ok — action items: Mira open Deal Desk ticket (done), attach signed LOI or prepay confirmation, attach proposed pricing sheet and POC SOW, Paula to attach DPA draft, Olivia to attach infra estimate. If all attached by Thu EOD we can route for expedited approval.
Mira: I have LOI PDF and verbal confirmation from CFO. Uploading now.
Devon-Cust: we'll send PO and wire confirmation once legal finalizes DPA.
Lee-Finance: final note — tag this as "Strategic Reference" in the ticket and cap overall lifetime discount stack to 45% including any credits. Approve if prepay shows in bank.
Paula-Legal: I'll drop draft DPA + SOC2 addendum in the ticket by EOD.
Sam-RevOps: great. If we get prepay + DPA + SOW, I will approve path A and queue for finance signature. :thumbsup:
Mira: thanks team — moving to close.
